subject: 590 Boston Avenue Site Plan Amendment
overview: The Community Development Board endorsed an Approval Not Required plan for Manning Street and recommended ZBA approval of an amended site plan for a 45-unit residential development at 590 Boston Avenue. The board also reviewed ongoing zoning ordinance cleanup drafts and discussed upcoming planning priorities.

items.title: 16 Manning Street ANR Plan
items.summary: Endorsed an Approval Not Required (ANR) plan to divide an 8,820-square-foot lot into two nonconforming residential parcels.

items.title: 590 Boston Avenue Advisory Site Plan Review Amendment
items.summary: Voted 5-0 to recommend ZBA approval of an amended site plan for a 45-unit residential building, which shifts the massing away from overhead utility lines and replaces ground-floor retail with tenant amenities. The recommendation includes advisory conditions regarding resident parking permit ineligibility, public art, and native plantings.

items.title: Zoning Cleanup Draft Amendment
items.summary: Reviewed progress on comprehensive zoning ordinance cleanups, focusing on refining definitions, resolving height specification errors in neighborhood corridor districts, and drafting introductory intent guidelines.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Board Business
items.summary: Discussed upcoming site plan review filings, planned educational sessions on the Dover Amendment, updates on city grant projects, and approved prior meeting minutes.
